name: Love RuRu Rworld
source:
RuRu is reunited with Rin, her childhood friend who secretly harbors feelings for her. Together, they delve into ancient ruins, only to uncover shocking truths that could change their world forever.


[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1993416767/love-ruru/]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
茹茹与青梅竹马的凛重逢，后者暗中对她怀有感情。他们一起深入古代遗迹，却发现了可能永远改变世界的令人震惊的真相。


[来自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1993416767/love-ruru/]Kickstarter[/url]]
